affordances.name: Cut
affordances.description: Can sever, slice, or shape suitable materials.

affordances.name: Thrust
affordances.description: Can pierce or stab into resistant materials.

affordances.name: Parry
affordances.description: Can deflect incoming melee attacks if wielded skillfully.

affordances.name: Illuminate
affordances.description: Can provide useful light in dark environments.

affordances.name: Ignite
affordances.description: Can set flammable materials on fire.

affordances.name: Signal
affordances.description: Can be used to communicate at distance through visibility or sound.

affordances.name: Improvised Weapon
affordances.description: Can be wielded as a weapon at reduced effectiveness.
